prompt: Create an original stop-motion felt-and-cardboard miniature of a friendly 2000s computer office after hours. Wide front-on stage, dusty lavender-blue background, peach desk, chunky pale mint CRT computer at center, little felt printer left and modem right, cables visible across floor, dark indigo base. Three tiny round-headed felt office workers in coral, yellow and mint waiting to go home, no faces more complex than dot eyes. Soft real studio light, tactile wool fibres, carefully crafted animation-film production still. Leave top third uncluttered lavender wall. No writing, letters, symbols, logos, interface text or borders. All characters and equipment entirely inside frame with breathing room. This will be the main interactive scene for a gentle shutdown puzzle; readable distinct silhouettes. Landscape 3:2.
